svg.title: A connected Africa
svg.desc: The countries of Africa in faint gold outline, with glowing points at cities across the continent joined by lines into one network: every builder connected to every other.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Nunito Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every point a builder. Every line a lesson shared.
